name: Balclutha
note: 1886 steel full-rigged ship: black hull, three square-rigged masts (San Francisco Maritime NHP) — moored along Hyde Street Pier; not in OSM, placed by hand (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts).

name: C.A. Thayer
note: 1895 three-masted lumber schooner — moored along Hyde Street Pier; not in OSM, placed by hand (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts).

name: Eureka
note: 1890 walking-beam paddle ferry, the longest of the park's ships — moored along Hyde Street Pier; not in OSM, placed by hand (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts).

name: Hercules
note: 1907 ocean-going steam tug — moored along Hyde Street Pier; not in OSM, placed by hand (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts).

name: Alma
note: 1891 scow schooner, Hyde Street Pier (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts). Claiming the way keeps it a building at bake time, for the model.

name: Santa Rosa
note: 1927 Bay ferry, now offices, by the Ferry Building (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts). Claiming the way keeps it a building at bake time, for the model.

name: San Francisco Belle
note: paddle-wheel party boat, by the Ferry Building (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts). Claiming the way keeps it a building at bake time, for the model.

name: SS Jeremiah O'Brien
note: 1943 Liberty ship, berthed at Pier 35 since 2023 per OSM (BUGS.md #251, src/render/landmarks/sf/ships.ts). Claiming the way keeps it a building at bake time, for the model.

name: Fort Point
note: 1861 brick casemate fort under the bridge (src/render/landmarks/sf/fort-point.ts); its lighthouse part is drawn by the model.

name: Treasure Island Building 2
note: Exposition palace, then Navy hangar: barrel vault, glazed ends.

name: Treasure Island Building 3
note: Exposition palace, then Navy hangar: barrel vault, glazed ends.

name: San Francisco County Jail #2
note: 425 7th Street: wavy glass curtain over a recessed ground floor (owner, 2026-10-02; Mapillary). Was a brick restyle.

name: Lombard Street gardens
note: Hedges and flower beds along the crooked block's switchbacks, from OSM's centreline (way/402111597).
